milestones.M2: Scaffolding: build system, primer, figure pipeline

tasks.title: Build and verify the annotated source corpus
tasks.objective: Search, retrieve, read and annotate every source both papers will cite. Produce refs.bib plus an annotation per source stating what it does, why it is credible, and what this work takes from it. Must include a serious prior-art check for Paper 1's component finding (journals, grey literature, spdep and ArcGIS documentation and issue trackers) and for Paper 2's selection problem. Report any source that narrows or preempts a claim.
validation: Every entry in refs.bib has an annotation
Every URL/DOI retrieved and confirmed to support its claim
Prior-art findings recorded in DECISIONS.md

tasks.title: Paper 1 evidence: disconnection prevalence at scale
tasks.objective: Determine how often k-nearest-neighbour spatial weights silently disconnect on real geography. Sweep n (subsamples of the 41,001-city frame plus the 319-city set) against k, recording component counts, largest-component share, per-component mean offsets, and the resulting Gi* cold/hot-spot rates under global vs within-component standardisation. Commit script and outputs.
validation: Script runs end to end from clean
Outputs include prevalence as a fraction of configurations, not one case
Seeded and deterministic

tasks.title: Paper 2 evidence: Type I inflation surface
tasks.objective: Extend the single-point inflation result into a surface. Vary selection rule (arg-max of I, min p-value, first-significant, and a robustness-check rule), candidate grid (coarse, fine, wide, narrow), n, and spatial configuration. Report false-positive rate against the 5 percent nominal, plus the inter-statistic correlation that governs how far short of Bonferroni the inflation falls. Commit script and outputs.
validation: At least three selection rules and two grids
Monte Carlo standard error below 0.5 percentage points
Seeded and deterministic

tasks.title: Write the shared from-first-principles primer
tasks.objective: Write papers/shared/primer.tex covering, for a reader with no statistics background: variability and standard deviation, z-scores, null hypotheses, p-values, permutation tests, Type I error and multiple comparisons, matrices and quadratic forms, eigenvalues and eigenvectors, graphs and connected components, spatial weights matrices, Moran's I, and Getis-Ord Gi*. Every term defined before use, each with an intuitive gloss before any formula.
validation: Compiles standalone
Every AC-003 term present and defined
No forward references to undefined terms

tasks.title: LaTeX build system and document scaffold
tasks.objective: Create papers/Makefile, the two document skeletons with section scaffolding, shared preamble, bibliography wiring, glossary support and table of contents. Must produce two compiling stub PDFs that already include the primer.
validation: make produces both PDFs with zero errors
TOC renders
tex authored via Write tool, not Bash heredoc

tasks.title: Paper 1 figures
tasks.objective: Generate all Paper 1 figures as vector PDFs from a committed script: the disconnected graph drawn on the map, the two-component value distributions against the global mean, Gi* z-score distributions by component, cold-spot counts before and after the within-component fix, and the prevalence surface from T-002.
validation: All figures vector PDF
Regenerate from clean
Each embeds in a test compile

tasks.title: Paper 2 figures
tasks.objective: Generate all Paper 2 figures as vector PDFs from a committed script: Moran's I against k with per-k critical values, the null distribution under fixed versus selected k, the Type I inflation surface across rules and grids, and the inter-statistic correlation structure that explains the shortfall from Bonferroni.
validation: All figures vector PDF
Regenerate from clean
Each embeds in a test compile

tasks.title: Write Paper 1 manuscript
tasks.objective: Write the full expository text of Paper 1: motivation from a hot-spot map a general reader recognises, the mechanism, the theory distinguishing level statistics from covariation statistics, the case study attributed as the author's own prior work, the prevalence evidence, the correction, the null result for Moran's I, a marked contribution section, limitations, and glossary. Maintain CLAIMS.md entries while writing.
validation: Compiles clean
Contribution and limitations sections in TOC
Every number has a CLAIMS.md row
Moran's I null result present

tasks.title: Write Paper 2 manuscript
tasks.objective: Write the full expository text of Paper 2: the neighbour-parameter choice and why it is invisible, what a p-value promises and how selection breaks that promise, the simulation evidence as a surface, the correlation structure governing the shortfall from Bonferroni, the selective-inference correction developed from first principles, the case study attributed as the author's own prior work, a marked contribution section, limitations, and glossary. Maintain CLAIMS.md entries while writing.
validation: Compiles clean
Contribution and limitations sections in TOC
Every number has a CLAIMS.md row

tasks.title: Audit: numerical traceability
tasks.objective: Independently verify every number in both PDFs. Extract all numeric claims from the compiled text, check each against CLAIMS.md, re-run the referenced scripts, and confirm agreement. Report any claim without a source or with a mismatched value as a defect.
validation: Every extracted number reconciled
Commands run and outputs recorded as evidence

tasks.title: Audit: source verification
tasks.objective: Independently retrieve every cited source and confirm it supports the claim attributed to it. Confirm every citation has an annotation meeting AC-004. Flag any source that cannot be retrieved or that does not support its claim.
validation: Each source retrieved with evidence recorded
Unsupported attributions reported as defects

tasks.title: Audit: accessibility and jargon
tasks.objective: Verify a reader with no statistics background can follow both papers. Extract the technical vocabulary from the compiled PDF text, confirm each term is defined before first substantive use and appears in the glossary, and confirm every section opens with a statement of what it establishes. Report undefined or late-defined terms as defects.
validation: Term inventory produced with definition location for each
No term used before definition

tasks.title: Final assembly and Definition-of-Done audit
tasks.objective: Resolve all defects raised by T-010 through T-012, rebuild both PDFs from clean, and verify every Definition-of-Done item in SPEC.md with recorded evidence. Produce a final acceptance report stating each DoD item and the evidence establishing it.
validation: Clean-clone make succeeds
Every DoD box ticked with evidence
No open defects

notes: T-002 and T-003 done in-context after all 5 subagents died (3 stream stalls, 2 account session limit). T-001/T-004/T-005 returned to ready; T-005 left papers/shared/preamble.tex partially written.
